0022600224.text: The Utah Jazz (1-10, 15th in the West and 7.5 games out in the Northwest) host the Orlando Magic (2-7, 12th in the East) in Utah's 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with the Jazz riding a nine-game losing streak and a 1-5 home record. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Jazz lost the 2025-26 series 0-2, most recently 120-117 in Orlando on February 7, 2026. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain) and Tristan da Silva (calf strain).
